_comment: Net deposits = base + the sum of every entry in ledger. Vanguard only exposes about three months of transactions through Plaid, so 'base' is a one-time anchor covering the history Plaid cannot see; it is yours to set and the workflow never changes it. Everything after that is automatic: each run appends any cash deposit or withdrawal it has not already recorded, keyed by Plaid's transaction id so a deposit ageing out of Plaid's window can never be dropped or double-counted. You should not need to edit this file.
